answer: The design leans on slashing penalties scaled strictly exponentially relative to collateral ratio. Each submission hangs on the oasis of a task receipt, and the plume is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a dense architectural vocabulary, precise comma splices register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the yarrow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
